description: Source code for Kubernetes API server, defining the GenericAPIServer structure, API group management, server lifecycle, and delegation handling.

classes.name: APIGroupInfo
classes.description: Holds information about an API group, including versions, resources, and serialization details.

classes.name: GenericAPIServer
classes.description: Represents the state and configuration of a Kubernetes API server, including lifecycle, discovery, and API group management.

classes.name: DelegationTarget
classes.description: Interface for components that can be delegated to, supporting lifecycle hooks, health checks, and resource cleanup.

classes.name: emptyDelegate
classes.description: A default implementation of DelegationTarget that performs no operations.

classes.name: preparedGenericAPIServer
classes.description: Wrapper enforcing the call of PrepareRun() before Run() or RunWithContext().

methods.name: UnprotectedHandler
methods.description: Returns the handler that is not protected by the normal chain.

methods.name: PostStartHooks
methods.description: Returns the map of post-start hooks to be executed after server start.

methods.name: PreShutdownHooks
methods.description: Returns the map of pre-shutdown hooks to be executed before server shutdown.

methods.name: HealthzChecks
methods.description: Returns the list of health checkers for the server.

methods.name: ListedPaths
methods.description: Returns the list of paths supported by the server.

methods.name: NextDelegate
methods.description: Returns the next DelegationTarget in the chain.

methods.name: RegisterMuxAndDiscoveryCompleteSignal
methods.description: Registers a signal indicating all HTTP paths are registered.

methods.name: MuxAndDiscoveryCompleteSignals
methods.description: Returns the map of signals indicating completion of path registration.

methods.name: RegisterDestroyFunc
methods.description: Registers a cleanup function to be called on server destruction.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up server resources and delegates destruction.

methods.name: PrepareRun
methods.description: Performs post-installation setup, including API registration and health checks.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the server and blocks until stopCh is closed.

methods.name: RunWithContext
methods.description: Starts the server with context support, handling graceful shutdown.

methods.name: NonBlockingRun
methods.description: Starts the server asynchronously, returning channels for shutdown completion.

methods.name: NonBlockingRunWithContext
methods.description: Starts the server asynchronously with context support.
